description: Source code for WKBrowser and WKBrowserContext classes in Playwright's WebKit implementation, managing browser connections, contexts, pages, and related events.

classes.name: WKBrowser
classes.description: Represents a WebKit browser instance, manages connections, contexts, and pages.

classes.name: WKBrowserContext
classes.description: Represents a browser context in WebKit, manages pages, cookies, permissions, and settings.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a WebKit browser and initializes the WKBrowser instance.

methods.name: doCreateNewContext
methods.description: Creates a new browser context with specified options.

methods.name: userAgent
methods.description: Returns the default user agent string.

methods.name: _onPageProxyCreated
methods.description: Handles creation of new page proxies.

methods.name: _onPageProxyMessageReceived
methods.description: Dispatches messages received from page proxies.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the browser connection is active.
